rules.publish_rate: PUBLISH_RATE requires: recall measured AND recall >= 0.9 AND precision_strict >= 0.9.
rules.publish_floor: PUBLISH_FLOOR requires: precision_strict >= 0.9 (a floor needs only precision).
rules.recall_not_run: Recall is NOT_RUN only when no recall artifact exists. The 98 source_ref harvest documents are declared lost, so the original route to a recall denominator is gone, and the corpus-derived reference frame replaces it on the channels the register covers.
rules.read_discipline: A failed read is UNKNOWN, never PASS. A percentage is never emitted where a cell is not PASS.

cells.why: measured on the imessage stratum only, under a broad ask definition that includes asks addressed to other humans; the register carries no harness or kcode conversations, so those channels are not measurable against it rather than zero
strict precision is below the 0.9 floor, so no floor can be published
two independent labellers on all three sheets; non-ask bucket is only substantial, which is the weakest link, not a gate
the precision sample covers the register's origin links, ~99% phone channel; harness-channel citations were not sampled
cells.source: link_residual_review.json target_namespaces, cross-checked against precision_scored.json denominator.sampled_from (ledger.db not present to re-derive directly)

decision_reason: citation_precision_strict is 0.7797 < 0.9, below the 0.9 floor every publication path needs, and recall is measured at 0.625, below 0.9, on the imessage stratum only (the register has no harness or kcode conversations); open cells: recall, citation_precision_strict.

coverage_pair.l3_note: a third blind reading resolved 11 of the 12 inter-labeller disagreements by majority of three, moving the non-ask operator count to 26 of 60. It is a third reading on the same rubric, not human ground truth, and it is reported alongside the pair, never instead of it

derived_envelope.definition: l2_point x precision_strict to l1_point x precision_lenient
derived_envelope.warning: a unit-share multiplied by a link-share: the two operands come from different denominators, so this is an envelope for intuition, never a figure to quote

does_not_retroactively_withdraw.why: different instrument and population; it never depended on citation precision

what_would_change_it: a measurable recall instrument (blocked: documents lost)
precision >= 0.9 at strict, which would still not overcome unmeasurable recall for a rate
